notes.title: Season of Pride Event + Release Date!
notes.notes:
Today marks the beginning of Season of Pride presented by MidBoss, IDGA, and Gayming Magazine! It's a festival celebrating a variety of queer games, including visual novels... like these!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44079813/aab0e4bb3bc37256bae1399b0190be747a20f493.png

Together with some friends we're celebrating queer visual novels in the festival. Check them out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2231680/Of_Sense_and_Soul/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2993720/Cage_of_Roses/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1803850/Lock__Key_A_Magical_Girl_Mystery/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1652580/Imperial_Grace/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3139260/Asphodelium/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2537980/Drculeti/

To celebrate the festival, we've got a special announcement.

Canvas Menagerie will release on December 18th! 🎉

In just under a month, the full game will release. We're excited to share it with you all!

Here's some brand new screenshots to close things off~
